statements.status_notes: libexpat before 2.7.5 can dereference a NULL function pointer when an external parameter entity with empty content is referenced inside an entity declaration value. Upstream fixed it in libexpat 2.7.5 with https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/5be25657583ea91b09025c858b4785834c20f59c (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1158); see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-32776. Checked libexpat.so in the libexpat package of every published build of the DHI Alpine 3.23 expat package on x86_64 and aarch64 (2.7.3-r0 to 2.10.0-r1): the version string in each library matches the package version, so 2.7.3-r0 and 2.7.4-r0 are built from libexpat 2.7.3 and 2.7.4, which lack the fix, and 2.7.5-r0 and later from libexpat 2.7.5 or later, which include it.

libexpat before 2.7.5 can dereference a NULL function pointer when an external parameter entity with empty content is referenced inside an entity declaration value. Upstream fixed it in libexpat 2.7.5 with https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/5be25657583ea91b09025c858b4785834c20f59c (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1158); see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-32776. Debian fixed it in trixie with expat 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6404-1). Checked libexpat.so and the Debian changelog in the libexpat1 package of every published DHI Debian 13 expat build on amd64 and arm64: the builds of Debian's 2.8.2-1~deb13u1, 2.8.3-1~deb13u1 and 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 report libexpat 2.8.2, 2.8.3 and 2.9.0 and their changelog lists CVE-2026-32776; the older builds report libexpat 2.7.1, which lacks the fix.
